title: Porous interior and residue after washing
text: Purchased the 20 oz. stainless steel tumbler to hold water during the day.  My husband has a leakproof Yeti which I like.  I understood this particular model is not leakproof (from the description), and I did not care how long the drinks stayed hot or cold.  What I did not suspect is that the inside of this tumbler was particularly porous.  I washed it several ways after receiving, ran through dishwasher, scrubbed with detergent, rinsed well (and emphasize, rinsed VERY well), tried drying it with a clean dishcloth, tried letting it air dry.  Yet every time I felt the inside it felt like there was some sort of residue in the inside of the tumbler.  My husband's Yeti feels totally different, smooth and clean.  The Yeti I received was packed in a plastic bag, did not look or feel like a Yeti product.  I am not comfortable drinking from this tumbler, much less leaving my water sit there for a few hours.

title: Quality is disappointing... Not the same as the older 'model'
text: Ok, I know everyone raves about the quality, and Yeti is the 'to go' product. HOWEVER, the quality of this new $35 purchase is not the same as my 2016 20oz Stainless Steel - not even close. There are two items I have lost in my travels these last few years (which I have had for 10+Yrs) - my Mink wrap scarf and my 2016 YETI! One was a cost issue, and the Yeti was my everyday cold water/ICE quality container (at hm and travelling) This newer model, just purchased, and within 20 minutes, I knew this was not the quality of the 2016 Yeti. 1) It is lighter 2) You can feel the temp (Cold) on the outside 3) It does not retain ICE - as expected. *my older version would have ice in the container the next morning. And the older lid did not have the slide cover. And this was an authorized Yeti seller, so as I know this new version is not a fake.
